# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/aws-vault
# args: 
usage: aws-vault [<flags>] <command> [<args> ...]

A vault for securely storing and accessing AWS credentials in development
environments.


Flags:
  --[no-]help                Show context-sensitive help (also try --help-long
                             and --help-man).
  --[no-]version             Show application version.
  --[no-]debug               Show debugging output
  --backend=secret-service   Secret backend to use [secret-service kwallet
                             keyctl pass file] ($AWS_VAULT_BACKEND)
  --prompt=PROMPT            Prompt driver to use [kdialog terminal]
                             ($AWS_VAULT_PROMPT)
  --keychain="aws-vault"     Name of macOS keychain to use, if it doesn't exist
                             it will be created ($AWS_VAULT_KEYCHAIN_NAME)
  --secret-service-collection="awsvault"  
                             Name of secret-service collection to use,
                             if it doesn't exist it will be created
                             ($AWS_VAULT_SECRET_SERVICE_COLLECTION_NAME)
  --pass-dir=PASS-DIR        Pass password store directory
                             ($AWS_VAULT_PASS_PASSWORD_STORE_DIR)
  --pass-cmd=PASS-CMD        Name of the pass executable ($AWS_VAULT_PASS_CMD)
  --pass-prefix=PASS-PREFIX  Prefix to prepend to the item path stored in pass
                             ($AWS_VAULT_PASS_PREFIX)
  --file-dir="~/.awsvault/keys/"  
                             Directory for the "file" password store
                             ($AWS_VAULT_FILE_DIR)

Commands:
help [<command>...]
    Show help.

add [<flags>] <profile>
    Add credentials to the secure keystore.

remove [<flags>] <profile>
    Remove credentials from the secure keystore.

list [<flags>]
    List profiles, along with their credentials and sessions.

rotate [<flags>] <profile>
    Rotate credentials.

exec [<flags>] <profile> [<cmd>] [<args>...]
    Execute a command with AWS credentials.

export [<flags>] <profile>
    Export AWS credentials.

clear [<profile>]
    Clear temporary credentials from the secure keystore.

login [<flags>] [<profile>]
    Generate a login link for the AWS Console.
